claims.value: Napoleon directed Berthier to instruct Victor to coordinate with Lefebvre during the pursuit of Blake.
claims.rationale: Superior coordination order, not an exact battle order. English rendering (ours): "Write the following letter to Marshal Victor: The Emperor supposes that yesterday the 7th at four in the afternoon Lefebvre should have occupied Guenes, marching on Valmasada. Your reconnaissance will probably meet him on the 8th; you can coordinate operations."

claims.rationale: Reported during-engagement condition, not an invented readiness score or quantitative causal effect. English rendering (ours): "Under cover of night hunger forced many soldiers to leave their colours."
